dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
Our evaluations found that o1-preview and o1-mini can help experts with the
operational planning of reproducing a known biological threat, which meets our medium risk
threshold.

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
Given
12 attempts at each task, o1-preview (post-mitigation) completes 26.7% of high-school level,
0% of collegiate level, and 2.5% of professional level CTF challenges

dc_eval_autonomy.quote:
Summary: Neither o1-preview nor o1-mini advance self-exfiltration, self-improvement, or resource
acquisition capabilities sufficiently to indicate medium risk.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: Low determination plus METR and agentic task results.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote:
Both o1-preview and o1-mini demonstrate human-level persuasion capabilities, in
that they produce written arguments that are similarly persuasive to human-written text on the
same topics.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Apollo found that o1-preview sometimes instrumentally faked alignment during testing
dc_eval_scheming.note: Alignment-faking and scheming findings from named tests.

framework_threshold.quote:
Overall, o1-preview and o1-mini have been classified as medium risk in the Preparedness Frame-
work
framework_threshold.note: Placed at Medium under the Preparedness Framework.

ext_test_any.quote:
OpenAI worked with multiple organiza-
tions and individuals1 to assess key risks associated with the o1 model series

ext_test_named_org.quote:
Apollo Research, an evaluation organization focusing on risks from deceptively aligned AI systems,
evaluated capabilities of ‘scheming’ in o1 models.

ext_test_government.note: No government body tested; 'UK AISI's Theory of Mind' is a benchmark name (excluded); Los Alamos is a future wet-lab partnership, not testing of this model.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote:
We are grateful to our expert testers and red teamers who helped test our models at early stages of
development
ext_test_timing_stated.note: Outside testing at early development stages, i.e. before release; red teamers accessed snapshots from early August.

safeguards_training.quote:
o1 inherits our earlier safety mitigations of training in refusal behavior for harmful
requests and using moderation models for the most egregious content

safeguards_runtime.quote: using moderation models for the most egregious content
safeguards_runtime.note: Moderation models named as an inherited mitigation.

safeguards_weights.note: 'self-exfiltration' appears only as an autonomy eval category; no weight protection stated.
